tob-10415: The sayings of Confucius, gathered by his disciples, have guided Chinese life for twenty-five centuries. tob-10815: The Kybalion sets out the seven Hermetic principles — from ‘the All is mind’ to the law of rhythm and polarity — said to descend from the teachings of Hermes Trismegistus. tob-4015: Giorgio Vasari, himself a painter, wrote the first great history of art — lives of the Italian masters from Cimabue to his own day. tob-0015: Archbishop William Wake’s 1693 set gathers the early Christian writings that never won a place in the New Testament — the gospels and letters the church laid aside.
